name: Col. Alexander William Adams
notable_stories: Served in the military in 1862 and joined the 3rd Missouri Cavalry, mustering out as a Sergeant in 1865

CONFLICT RESOLVED: Col. Alexander William Adams served in the UNION Army during the Civil War, joining the 3rd Missouri Cavalry in 1862 as private and mustering out as Sergeant in 1865. Primary source (Adams Family Doc) explicitly states Union Army.
After the war Alexander moved back home, became a farmer, and married Unknown Ashby. She died soon after giving birth to their son Henry in 1868.
Alexander married Mary Martin January 17, 1871 in Chariton County, Missouri.
